status: fixed before first formal fixture computation
question: For fixed synthetic patch features X and a, construct exact full conditional mean/covariance Gaussian controls for shared-channel clipping C and independent-token clipping E*, and test a prespecified direction intervention.
budget_policy: One continuous wall-clock deadline from the first supervised worker launch, including import, failed attempts, recovery and retries. Preparation and post-run archival are not fixture computation. No result-dependent parameter changes or extra runs.
dependencies: Existing Python standard library, NumPy and Torch only. No third-party source execution, downloads of images/weights, training, backward, optimizer, GPU or Colab.

direction.rule: Project fixed anchor onto span{ones,mu} orthogonal complement, normalize, Q=I-2vv^T. No alternate anchor if invalid. Check constant, T=2 and a=0 degeneracy; no-clip is an intentionally commuting negative control.

mc.role: fixed-size secondary smoke check; no covariance estimation is used to construct a control

tolerances.tiny_scale_policy: Normalize means/factors by d and covariances by d^2 before comparisons; do not hide epsilon-scale errors under unscaled atol.

required_checks: piecewise polynomial integration vs two-node Gauss-Legendre
structured basis action equals every dense factor column
full C/E marginals match but off-diagonals differ
affine squared expected loss equality for each matched pair
fixed nonzero scalar and mixed cubic moments
one 196x768 structured shape and memory check
interpretation: Passing qualifies the mathematical controls only. Moment-matched affine squared expected loss is a known identity, not a new theorem. No claims about CE, finite SGD trajectories, model accuracy, publication novelty, or bitwise reproduction of FroFA. No automatic continuation into data/model training.
